title: The Alpha-1 Foundation's and University of Florida's Alpha-1 Coded Testing (ACT) Study
official: The Alpha-1 Foundation's and University of Florida's Alpha-1 Coded Testing (ACT) Study
summary: The Alpha-1 Coded Testing (ACT) Study was established to study genetic testing and outcomes of individuals at risk for alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Individuals of any age at risk for alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency on the basis of symptoms or family genetic risk.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Any person who has already had genotype and AAT level testing completed and has a qualified result.
